initial_probe: The native3.4.0 element-material tangent response is not exposed; the generic DP factory is not a direct3D test object.
resolution: NDTest stresses are queried through an identity InitialStateAnalysisWrapper to obtain the same ThreeDimensional DP copy that a brick requests; InitialStateAnalysis is never activated.
method: Central strain differences around a small positive plastic trial increment, without committing the perturbations. Comparison is with the continuum loading tangent, not a measured experimental tangent.
